name: Workspace and engineering foundation
outcome: build and change the product reproducibly
deliverable: A versioned monorepo with locked toolchains, generated contracts and enforced module boundaries
acceptance: A clean supported machine can bootstrap and run the owned-code checks without relying on LocalMind dependencies.

name: Native host and sidecar lifecycle
outcome: run a stable desktop application with controlled native access
deliverable: A launchable Tauri host with a supervised Python runtime, scoped IPC and vaulted credentials
acceptance: The actual native app starts, remains responsive, handles sidecar failure and exits without orphaning owned processes.

name: Task-first user experience
outcome: delegate work and understand progress, exceptions and results
deliverable: A task composer, activity view, approval review, results and settings with rendered accessibility evidence
acceptance: A user completes the core flow through the rendered desktop UI using mouse and keyboard at supported sizes.

name: Task contracts and persistence
outcome: preserve task state and evidence across failures
deliverable: Typed contracts, transactional task storage, resumable events and verified artifact storage
acceptance: Restart, concurrency, backup and interrupted-write tests preserve consistent task and artifact state.

name: Model providers and inference controls
outcome: use real inference with observable capabilities and resource limits
deliverable: Local and hosted provider adapters with streaming, cancellation, usage accounting and governed fallback
acceptance: Real model calls pass the provider contract and restricted data never reaches an unapproved fallback provider.

name: Agent loop and tool execution
outcome: complete bounded multi-step tasks through typed tools
deliverable: A durable bounded agent loop, validated tool registry, safe execution and idempotent operation ledger
acceptance: A real tool-using run succeeds and malformed actions, retries and uncertain writes preserve the declared invariants.

name: Permissions, approvals and audit
outcome: authorize exact actions and trace their effects
deliverable: Execution-time policies, immutable approval scopes, revocation and verifiable audit exports
acceptance: Changed proposals, revoked grants, injected instructions and duplicate decisions produce no unauthorized effects.

name: Document intake and evidence
outcome: supply business documents with inspectable field provenance
deliverable: Validated PDF, OCR, tabular and email intake with versions, corrections and stable citations
acceptance: Supported documents retain source locations and malformed or low-confidence data cannot silently become trusted facts.

name: Invoice exception employee
outcome: resolve invoice exceptions with evidence and approved draft actions
deliverable: A complete invoice-to-resolution workflow and a stateful fixture ERP
acceptance: A real model processes fixtures through matching, review, one idempotent draft write and a verified reconciliation result.

name: Durable remote workflows
outcome: resume long-running work after outages and human review
deliverable: Temporal workers, review signals, reconciliation, compensation and replay-compatible versions
acceptance: Worker loss, delayed approval and duplicate delivery do not duplicate effects or lose unresolved outcomes.

name: Enterprise connector framework
outcome: connect permitted test systems through consistent contracts
deliverable: Connector manifests, MCP, OAuth, sandbox drive/ticket adapters and sanitized recordings
acceptance: At least one configured sandbox integration passes live contract tests, throttling and revocation checks.

name: Retrieval and context construction
outcome: retrieve relevant permitted evidence and identify retrieval failures
deliverable: Versioned chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking and context assembly
acceptance: Held-out retrieval results include recall and citation coverage, and stale or cross-tenant evidence is excluded.

name: Reviewed memory and context graph
outcome: reuse relevant experience without leaking or accumulating false lessons
deliverable: Scoped reviewed memories, conflict resolution, expiry, provenance graph and transfer tests
acceptance: Memory-on/off tests distinguish transfer from memorization and revocation removes influence on subsequent runs.

name: Reproducible task environments
outcome: repeat realistic tasks and test rewards before optimization
deliverable: Snapshot environments, simulated users, fault injection, verifiable rewards and isolated resets
acceptance: A fixed seed reproduces initial state and reward exploits fail before environment use in training.

name: Evaluation and statistical evidence
outcome: separate real improvements from leakage, judge bias and run variance
deliverable: Repeated-run evaluation, calibrated judges, paired statistics and gated comparison reports
acceptance: Candidate reports include complete denominators, independent-unit uncertainty, quality, latency, cost and leakage checks.

name: Trace-to-dataset engine
outcome: turn permitted reviewed traces into reproducible training data
deliverable: Redacted trajectories, preference pairs, quality diagnostics, lineage and TRL exports
acceptance: Every exported row has permitted source lineage and withdrawn or rejected data is excluded from new dataset versions.

name: Post-training and model promotion
outcome: test a defensible training intervention against the unchanged model
deliverable: Hardware preflight, SFT/DPO entry points, checkpoint evaluation, serving and controlled promotion
acceptance: One completed experiment reports held-out task and retention results; a clean negative result also satisfies research completion.

name: Inference efficiency and intervention research
outcome: improve complete-task quality within latency and cost budgets
deliverable: Routing, selective verification, safe caching and reproducible intervention comparisons
acceptance: A full-agent comparison against declared baselines includes failed attempts, cost uncertainty and transfer limitations.

name: Observability and reliability
outcome: diagnose degradation and verify recovery under load
deliverable: Traces, metrics, redacted diagnostics, SLO rules, alerts and failure/load scenarios
acceptance: Injected failures are visible in telemetry and recovery preserves correct business state within measured limits.

name: Security and data governance
outcome: protect credentials, tenant data and executable boundaries
deliverable: Filesystem/egress enforcement, plugin verification, retention and adversarial security tests
acceptance: Real boundary tests deny cross-scope access, secret leaks and unauthorized effects; scanner failures fail closed.

name: Team services and infrastructure
outcome: operate isolated workspaces and durable workers remotely
deliverable: OIDC, PostgreSQL isolation, object storage, service containers and optional remote deployment infrastructure
acceptance: Two test tenants remain isolated across API, storage and work execution, and containers start from locked inputs.

name: GitHub delivery pipelines
outcome: ship only artifacts with reviewable quality and provenance evidence
deliverable: PR, integration, UI, native, supply-chain, GPU and staged promotion workflows
acceptance: Actual GitHub runs demonstrate required-gate failure behavior and protect release credentials from untrusted code.

name: Desktop distribution and upgrades
outcome: install, update and recover the application safely
deliverable: Installer, controlled signing, updater, migration recovery and release evidence verifier
acceptance: An isolated Windows profile installs and upgrades the app with intact user data; unavailable signing remains explicitly unsigned.

name: Additional workflows and contributor ecosystem
outcome: extend the engine and demonstrate transfer beyond invoice tasks
deliverable: Onboarding/access fixtures, optional multimodal IO, skill registry, SDK and contributor kit
acceptance: Implemented extensions pass the shared contracts and cross-domain evaluation reports do not reuse training families.
